name: cinewright-craft
description: Film craft skills for AI video: cinewright-script (logline, beats, scene turns, dialogue for generated voices), cinewright-design (turnaround sheets, clean references, prop descriptions, costume arc, color script) and cinewright-movement (weight, one phrase per shot, fights, hard subjects). Camera, edit, finish, sound and history come later. Needs the cinewright plugin.
